queries.name: TaskList
queries.ordering: current operational-plan start nulls last, then task_id; alternate explicit sort registries allowed
queries.rule: cursor pagination never changes exact total semantics and never treats provider status as Task execution/outcome

queries.name: TaskWorkbench
returns: Local Task name or WFM Task No.
WFM owning RFC + derived root/subordinate/SR context
current operational Task plan + history summary
current Objective membership with pinned plan revision
direct SR/RFC/Device Reference relationships permitted by kind
queries.rule: source plan, current operational plan, membership-pinned plan, Objective envelope and actual execution are rendered as distinct named facts

queries.name: ObjectiveList
queries.ordering: effective start in selected Objective timezone/UTC instant then objective_id; unscheduled current Objectives do not exist
queries.rule: Customer/RFC/SR/Device filters derive through Tasks and never require Objective-owned duplicate relationship columns

queries.name: ObjectiveWorkbench
returns: reviewed envelope from membership-pinned Task plans
one task_id-ordered bounded current-member page with current-plan-vs-pinned-plan mismatch indicators
derived SR/RFC/Device/Customer context summary with provenance
Task-level actual execution and outcome for returned member page
current valid Objective review or stale-review marker
predecessor/successor context derived from Task retries
rules: the Objective never exposes editable direct SR/RFC/Device/Inventory relationships
member paging is presentation-only; complete authoritative membership remains server-side input to envelope/aggregate/review/nonempty guards and is never inferred from one page

queries.name: ObjectiveContextByTaskRelationships
returns: context rows typed sr|rfc|device|customer with source_task_id and relationship provenance
rules: Local Task SR/RFC links are direct Task relationships
WFM RFC context comes from its owning RFC; SR context derives through governing-root SR links
Device context is direct Task-to-DeviceReference only

queries.name: GroupingProposalList
queries.rule: large proposal membership is not materialized in list rows

queries.name: GroupingProposalDetail
queries.rule: preview never reinterprets a stale proposal as current; caller must explicitly recompute

queries.name: TaskGroupingEligibility
queries.rule: wall-clock passage alone does not create plan/membership locks; ordinary automatic creation uses future/noncancelled eligibility while historical provider-Complete structure uses its separate proposal path

queries.name: ObjectiveOverlapNeighbors
returns: current nonsuperseded Objective ids/envelopes satisfying start < candidate_end AND end > candidate_start
queries.rule: exact touch is excluded; authoritative acceptance uses current UnitOfWork version of this query

queries.name: ObjectiveMonthlyOrdinal
queries.algorithm: choose aggregate actual_start_utc when known else objective envelope start_utc; convert only for calendar month bucket/presentation; within same bucket order by effective_start_utc then immutable objective_id and return 1-based position
rules: current ordinal is derived and may recalculate
cross-month Objective belongs to effective start month
historical completed report labels are frozen by reporting owner rather than this live query

queries.name: ObjectiveReviewQueue
returns: Objective rows whose aggregate is awaiting_review or whose prior review fingerprint is stale
queries.rule: due is a projection from accepted plan/execution state; it never fabricates Task outcome or actual end

queries.name: WfmSourceTerminalReviewQueue
queries.rule: provider Complete/Plan Cancel may be visible here without any local termination having occurred

queries.name: HistoricalObjectiveProposalList
queries.rule: no actual execution/outcome fields are inferred from provider completion

queries.name: RfcTerminalTaskCascadePreview
returns: in-progress Objectives that would lose final executable Task
INDETERMINATE if complete bounded authority cannot be established
queries.rule: read-only preview preserves provider WFM status and excludes unrelated Local Tasks

queries.name: TaskHardDeletePreview
queries.rule: detail is bounded/paged; commit reruns complete indexed guards in current UoW

queries.name: ObjectiveCreationPreview
input: existing Task ids and current plan revisions and/or UI-draft Local Task definitions with explicit plans
returns: CREATE with exact prospective member/plan fingerprint and derived envelope, or REGROUP_REQUIRED with exact overlap/regroup context
rules: validate every proposed member has or receives complete accepted interval
compute strict global overlap against all eligible Tasks/current Objective envelopes
selected/prospective task that joins or bridges current Objective work returns regroup-required instead of authorizing an overlapping Objective
UI draft may be empty temporarily but no persistence occurs
no command receipt, revision, audit event, proposal row or external effect is created

queries.name: ObjectiveHardDeletePreview
queries.rule: only untouched manual Objective correction path can be eligible; Task identities are retained unless separately eligible/deleted

queries.name: GetObjectiveTimezone
returns: OBJECTIVE_TIMEZONE_V1 typed value from LLD-02 SettingStore or accepted default
rules: timezone affects LLD-05 scheduling interpretation/presentation only
ordinary and SLA chronology remain America/Guayaquil under their owning contracts

pagination.strategy: deterministic keyset cursors signed/validated by server transport policy
pagination.exact_totals: computed separately or maintained as exact projection/count query; never page length

read_consistency: Workbench/review previews use one LLD-01 stable read snapshot. Authoritative acceptance re-reads all safety-critical revisions/relationships under current UnitOfWork.
